title: Production AI Chatbot Backend - RAG, Memory, Analytics

sections.label: 1 · THE CONVERSATION
sections.note: Every message arrives with a user id and a session id, so the bot knows who it is talking to before it thinks.

sections.label: 2 · HOW THE ANSWER GETS BUILT
sections.note: One agent, with your knowledge base and your REST API attached to it. It has to cite where the answer came from.

sections.label: 3 · REPLY, HAND OFF, AND LOG EVERY TURN
sections.note: Low confidence goes to a human with the full thread. Everything else streams back and gets written down either way.

sections.label: 4 · KEEPING THE KNOWLEDGE BASE CURRENT
sections.note: Runs on its own every night. This is the part that stops the bot answering from last quarter's docs.

sections.label: 5 · WHEN SOMETHING BREAKS
sections.note: A failed run pings me with a link to it. Nothing fails quietly in front of a customer.

input_sample.message: my invoice for august says 2 seats but we added a third on the 12th, why wasn't it billed?

output_sample.answer: Seats added mid-cycle are prorated onto the next invoice, not the current one. Your third seat was added 12 Aug, so it appears on the September invoice as a prorated line of $34.00 plus the full $49.00 seat charge.
output_sample.if_confidence_had_been_low: Slack handoff fires with the full thread, the sources it did find, and a link back to the session, instead of guessing at a billing answer
